Nina Torres: FYI — Keystone Analytics flagged by renewal ops. Usage down 46% month-over-month, procurement reached out about alternative vendor.
ops-bot: [ALERT] account_usage_drop: 46% | action: renewal_watch_created
Evan Liu: timeline on when procurement looped in? any churn signals from their champions?
Nina Torres: procurement pinged last Tues. Champion (Alex) left in week 6 of onboarding; new ML lead Priya Rao onboarding now.
Priya Rao: hey team, just joined. We're running a vendor bakeoff (NimbusAI + Redwood) focused on inference cost and latency for our 512-token pipelines. Curious about any short-term pilot offers.
Tom K.: procurement wants a 1-page TCO and a small hands-on trial before QBR. Can you provide latency/cost and retention/security details?
Maya Singh: quick snapshot from telemetry: ```30d active seats: 14 -> 8
avg tokens/day: 260k -> 138k
sessions per user down 35%```
Evan Liu: thanks. Proposed triage: 1) set urgent sync with Priya + Tom this week 2) provide p50/p95 latency & cost per 1k for their 512 trace 3) propose 10-day Dedicated pilot with usage rebate 4) capture top prompts to validate quality parity 5) security/KMS doc attached 6) designate exec sponsor for QBR
Nina Torres: I'll schedule Thu 11am PT. Evan, can you run the latency sweep? Maya, export anonymized prompts and top failing flows.
Maya Singh: dropping sanitized prompt examples now.
ops-bot: note created: renewal_triage_keystone_1812346789 | priority: high
Evan Liu: baseline numbers (local run): ```redwood base p50 115ms p95 230ms | cost/1k $1.05
redwood quant8 p50 130ms p95 255ms | cost/1k $0.69
NimbusAI reported p50 95ms p95 210ms | list cost/1k $0.85```
Priya Rao: important: accuracy on our entity-extraction prompts matters more than raw latency. Also we need logging + retention details for HIPAA-adjacent datasets.
Nina Torres: noted. Maya will attach KMS/HSM + retention FAQ. Evan, can you prepare a quality comparison on their top 6 prompts for Thu?
Evan Liu: will run A/B on the 6 prompts and include failure cases. ETA 5pm today.
Maya Singh: uploaded security summary: KMS integration + VPC peering options + data retention windows.
Tom K.: procurement asks for commercial flexibility if Nimbus undercuts list price. What's typical fallback?
Nina Torres: suggest a blended offer: short pilot discount + a retention rebate if they stay past 3 months. Riley (pricing) to confirm legal thresholds.
Priya Rao: appreciate the responsiveness. We'll review the pilot terms on Thu. Looking forward to seeing quality examples.
Evan Liu: handing off slides: latency table, cost table, prompt A/B, recommended pilot terms.
Nina Torres: assignments: Evan (benchmarks & prompt A/B), Maya (security doc + prompt export), Nina (schedule & exec sponsor), Riley (commercial fallback). I'll brief exec sponsor pre-QBR.
ops-bot: thread status set to pending_followup.
Nina Torres: closing loop for now. Posting call notes after Thu sync. Thanks team :thumbsup:
